title: 2012 HMMT February Guts Problem 2
statement: Let \(a_{0}, a_{1}, a_{2}, \ldots\) denote the sequence of real numbers such that \(a_{0}=2\) and \(a_{n+1}=\frac{a_{n}}{1+a_{n}}\) for \(n \geq 0\). Compute \(a_{2012}\).

solutions.text: \(\frac{2}{4025}\) Calculating out the first few terms, note that they follow the pattern \(a_{n}=\frac{2}{2 n+1}\). Plugging this back into the recursion shows that it indeed works.
